privacy-description: Information for teachers, staff, students and legal representatives affected by the use of this instance.
privacy-controller-note: In French public education, the controller depends on who initiated the deployment and on the education level. It must be identified with the competent DPO before the service is used; the software authors are not automatically the controller.
privacy-purposes-text: Data is used to administer and secure accounts; manage classes, students, question banks and quizzes; record answers and scores; support human marking; report factual monitoring events during supervised quizzes; and protect the service through two-factor authentication, rate limits and security logs.
privacy-legal-basis-note: A public-interest task may be relied on by a public authority only when the processing is necessary for a task laid down by law. Student consent must therefore not be stated as the default basis.
privacy-data-text: Teacher and administrator account identifiers, display names, password hashes, encrypted two-factor secrets, status, dates and sessions; student identifiers, display names, class and level; participation, answers, scores and marking status; factual quiz-monitoring events; authentication IP addresses, hashed technical identifiers and rate-limit data; and problem-report messages, affected page and submission date. The report form asks for no name, address or user account.
privacy-data-source: Data comes from administrators, teachers and students when they use the service. The supplied code contains no advertising, profiling or audience-measurement tool.
privacy-recipients-note: The administrator manages accounts; each teacher accesses only their own classes, quizzes and results; a student accesses only their temporary quiz session. Any hosting provider or technical service provider with access must be governed by the operator.
privacy-retention-quiz-value_one: Automatically deleted after {{count}} day, with earlier deletion available to the teacher.
privacy-retention-quiz-value_other: Automatically deleted after {{count}} days, with earlier deletion available to the teacher.
privacy-retention-reports-value_one: Deleted by the administrator or automatically after no more than {{count}} day.
privacy-retention-reports-value_other: Deleted by the administrator or automatically after no more than {{count}} days.
privacy-decisions-text: Multiple-choice scores are calculated from the teacher’s marking scheme. Written answers require human marking. Monitoring events are factual alerts for the teacher: the software imposes no sanction and makes no automated decision about them.
privacy-rights-text: Depending on the legal basis and circumstances, you may request access, rectification, erasure or restriction, and object for reasons relating to your particular situation. Contact the controller or DPO shown above. Proof of identity may be requested only where there is reasonable doubt.
privacy-complaint-before-link: If the response is unsatisfactory, you may lodge a complaint with
privacy-education-title: Before use in French public education
privacy-education-text: The controller must consult its DPO, record the processing activity, verify that the data—especially monitoring data—is necessary and proportionate, govern processors, and inform students and their representatives in suitable language. Availability of the code is neither ministerial approval nor certification.
